Cursed Satan vowed to take a portion of Allah's servants, mislead them, stir desires and make them alter Allah's creation; his promises are delusion and his followers' refuge is Hell.
The children of Adam are warned not to let Satan tempt them as he removed their parents from Paradise; he and his tribe see them from where they cannot see.
When an evil suggestion comes from Satan, seek refuge in Allah; those who fear Allah remember Him and see clearly, while the devils increase their brothers in error.
When the matter is concluded, Satan says he promised and betrayed, had no authority except to invite, and tells his followers to blame themselves, not him.
When reciting the Quran, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, who has no authority over believers who rely on their Lord, only over those who take him as an ally.
Allah has sent devils upon the disbelievers to incite them, so do not be impatient over them, for their time is counted.
Some dispute about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil, and whoever turns to a devil is misguided by him and led to the punishment of the Blaze.
Satan threw something into the speech of every messenger or prophet, but Allah abolishes it and makes His verses precise, a trial for diseased hearts while the knowledgeable believe.
Believers must not follow Satan's footsteps, for he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing, and none would be pure without Allah's favor and mercy.
The devils descend upon every sinful liar, passing on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
Iblees found his assumption about them true and they followed him, except some believers; he had no authority, but Allah would make clear who believes in the Hereafter.
Allah's promise is true, so people must not be deluded by worldly life or the Deceiver; Satan is their enemy, inviting his party to the Blaze.
If an evil suggestion comes from Satan, seek refuge in Allah, the Hearing, the Knowing.
Whoever is blinded from the remembrance of the Most Merciful is given a devil companion who averts him while he thinks himself guided, until he regrets it on the Day.
